title: Microsoft Purview: retention based on last accessed date for SharePoint and OneDrive files
summary: The briefing accurately reports Microsoft's planned Office-file deletion scope and rollout windows, and keeps SharePoint archiving behaviour separate from Purview's undocumented details. The licensing model understates the published general retention entitlements; feature-specific requirements remain unpublished.

claims.quote: This creates the ability to apply Retention to each SharePoint or OneDrive item based on when it was last accessed by a user.

claims.claim: Current Learn guidance lists four retention-period start points.
claims.quote: When the content was created. ... When the content was last modified. ... When the content was labeled. ... When an event occurs.

claims.claim: Content creation is a documented retention-period start point.
claims.quote: When the content was created. The default start of the retention period.

claims.claim: Last modification is a documented retention-period start point.
claims.quote: When the content was last modified. Supported only for files in the SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 Groups locations.

claims.claim: The last-modified start point is supported only for SharePoint, OneDrive and Microsoft 365 Groups files.
claims.quote: Supported only for files in the SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 Groups locations.

claims.claim: The date content was labelled is a documented start point.
claims.quote: When the content was labeled. Available with retention labels, for documents in SharePoint and OneDrive, and for email items.

claims.claim: An event is a documented retention-period start point.
claims.quote: When an event occurs. Available with retention labels that are configured for event-based retention, such as when employees leave the organization or contracts expire.

claims.claim: The announced last-accessed option adds another start point to the currently documented four.
claims.quote: After the rollout, admins can use the retention control When items were last accessed when configuring labels and policies.
